description:
pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:512, :534 — Both constructors return Result<Self, der::Error>:

  pub fn issuer_dn_exact(name: &x509_cert::name::Name) -> Result<Self, der::Error>
  pub fn serial_range(issuer: &x509_cert::name::Name, start: Vec<u8>, end: Vec<u8>) -> Result<Self, der::Error>

der::Error is RustCrypto/formats' pre-1.0 (currently 0.7.x) error type whose semver-major is now pinned to pkix-lint's public API. When `der` cuts a major version — or restructures its Error type in a 0.x bump — both constructors' signatures break unconditionally, even for callers who do not care about der-level details.

CALLER IMPACT: A caller writing:
  match DeviationScope::issuer_dn_exact(&name) {
      Ok(scope) => { ... }
      Err(e) => log::error!("malformed name DN: {e}"),
  }

depends on the concrete der::Error type. If their crate also depends on der at a different major (because, e.g., a different transitive dep pulled der 1.0), the types stop unifying.

REMEDIATION: Wrap der::Error in a pkix-lint-local opaque error type. Either:

1. Add a new variant to DeviationAddError:
     pub enum DeviationAddError {
         ...
         #[error("malformed DER in deviation scope: {0}")]
         MalformedScopeDer(String),
     }
   and map der::Error to String at the constructor boundary. Loses fine-grained error data but pkix-lint doesn't expose der-level details elsewhere either.

2. Introduce DeviationScopeError as a dedicated error type:
     #[non_exhaustive]
     pub enum DeviationScopeError {
         MalformedIssuerDn { detail: String },
         InvalidSerialRange { detail: String },
     }
   and map der::Error inside the constructor.

Both options decouple pkix-lint's public surface from der's evolution.

Combined with the &x509_cert::Name parameter leak (separate finding — same constructors), fixing both produces:

  pub fn issuer_dn_exact(issuer_der: &[u8]) -> Result<Self, DeviationScopeError>
  pub fn serial_range(issuer_der: &[u8], start: Vec<u8>, end: Vec<u8>) -> Result<Self, DeviationScopeError>

with zero direct exposure to either x509-cert or der in the DeviationScope public surface.

Pre-1.0 free fix.
title: DeviationScope::issuer_dn_exact and ::serial_range return Result<_, der::Error>; pins der pre-1.0 major version into pkix-lint public API
